options.text: Draw base $AB$ of $4$ cm, construct a perpendicular at $A$ and at $B$, mark $4$ cm on each perpendicular to get $D$ and $C$, then join $DC$.
Draw a base of $4$ cm and raise perpendiculars at both ends, but mark any new lengths on those perpendiculars.
The upright sides are produced by first writing the area $16$ cm$^{2}$.
Find the area $16$ cm$^{2}$ first, and treat that area calculation as the construction of the square.

stem:
Diya must construct a square of side $4$ cm with ruler and compass.

Which plan forces the square?

teacher.key_rationale: Base 4 cm, perpendiculars at both ends, mark 4 cm on each, join the top. B omits equal side lengths on the perpendiculars. C reverses construction order around area. D treats area as the construction itself.
